turn.context: Playbook §7, points 1 and 4: a low-risk trial first, then a choice. Either choice moves the conversation to another place.

text: Start with a two-week trial on one ward. Begin with the consultants who decide latest, because they gain the most.
It needs no new staff and no new system. It turns our biggest guess into a measured fact.
chat.pointer: Pick a step for its detail. The two doors at the end are your choice of what comes next.
chat.invite: Which would you like to go into first?
chat.note: Prove it on one ward, then decide on the rest.
